hemType.elastic.d: Folded back hem with elastic inside

hemType.ribknit.d: Hem is replaced with rib knit

waistbandType.ribknit.d: Waistband is replaced with rib knit

articulatedKneeNo.d: Do not make the knee articulated

legLength.capris.d: Pant legs just below the knee

legLength.custom.d: Set your own pant leg length

legLengthCustom.d: Set your own pant leg length

frontPocketType.hole.d: Curved front pocket with a hole opening

frontPocketType.diamond.d: Front pocket with a diamond shaped hole

backPocketType.diamond.d: Back pocket with a diamond shaped hole

frontPocketCargoYes.d: Add a strip of fabric to add depth to the front pocket

backPocketCargoYes.d: Add a strip of fabric to add depth to the back pocket

frontPocketInsideYes.t: Move the pocket to the inside
frontPocketInsideYes.d: The patch pocket now becomes an internal pocket

frontPocketInsideNo.d: The pocket is on the outside

backPocketInsideYes.t: Move the pocket to the inside
backPocketInsideYes.d: The patch pocket now becomes an internal pocket

backPocketInsideNo.d: The pocket is on the outside

backPocketCargoWidth.d: Adjust the width of the extra strip of fabric

fullness.d: Add extra fullness to the pant legs

waistReduction.d: Make the waist band smaller than calculated

HipsShift.d: Shifts fabric from the front to the back. This is to compensate if you need extra space around the hips in the back of the front. Negative numbers move it to the back.

gussetDepth.d: How far down the leg the gusset extends

gussetWidthFront.d: How far up the front seam the gusset extends

gussetWidthBack.d: How far up the back seam the gusset extends

gussetExtraSpace.d: Adds extra space between the front and the back in the gusset
